# Dutch Grand Prix Preview

Red Bull faces a pivotal test at Zandvoort as the championship battle intensifies following the summer break, with Isack Hadjar sidelined by a wrist injury that forces a tactical reshuffle for the team. McLaren and Ferrari circle the defending champions at a circuit that demands precision through the high-speed corners, offering midfield rivals a rare opportunity to exploit any setup vulnerabilities. Victory this weekend could prove decisive in narrowing the points gap before the season's critical final phase, as teams make their final push at Zandvoort before F1 departs the Dutch venue permanently.
